chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Meets Mu Northson in the Black-White College Lightning Gauntlet - Desolate Era Ch. 156
chapter_meta_description: The Black-White College's first trial unleashes 810 lightning constructs. Ji Ning breezes through, befriends a 14-year-old puppet prodigy, and discovers the horrifying power of divine sense attacks. But a final, deadlier test still waits.
og_title: Eight Hundred Lightning Bolts Can't Stop Ji Ning
og_description: A new prodigy appears! Mu Northson, a 14-year-old puppet master, bonds with Ji Ning as they survive the brutal first stage of the Black-White College trials.
twitter_title: Ji Ning finds a fellow monster genius!
twitter_description: The lightning gauntlet falls, but Ji Ning and Mu Northson rise above it. Divine sense attacks and a deadly final test await in this explosive chapter.
